name: Brunna Darkiron
source_profile:
Marshal Brunna Darkiron (LN) is a veteran commander who oversees the western mountain

approaches. She values discipline and the preservation of her people above political loyalty. Though she faithfully enforces the council's laws, Brunna deeply resents the illithids' interference in military affairs and fears that their growing demands will eventually destroy the realm she has spent her life defending.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 79 (source excerpt; may be partial)
